snippet.title: Backrooms: Wit's End - Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Backrooms: Wit's End is an immersive coop survival horror game, featuring procedurally generated, unnerving levels and dynamic gameplay mechanics. Explore the different disturbing levels with your friends, while trying to escape from many puzzling entities.

Out November 26th on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419010/Backrooms_Wits_End
